methods.source_location: Methods and Table I: five ku-series Au pressure checks
methods.scope: diagnostic pressure_au_gpa column only; not the adopted EOS pressure coordinate

recalculation.notes: The source prints reduced ruby and Au pressures but not ruby R1 shifts or Au lattice parameters. Observation-by-observation pressure recalculation is therefore impossible.

assessment.basis: Every compared free coefficient meets both the recorded combined-two-sigma comparison and parameter-specific numerical similarity screen. Error conventions and fit qualifications remain applicable.

fit.solver_message: Both `ftol` and `xtol` termination conditions are satisfied.

locations: EOS discussion, Figure 2, Figure 3, and Table II, pages 105-106
primary_source_check.finding: The source reports a preferred fixed-K0_prime BM3 and a secondary unconstrained BM3 for one Pbnm Mg0.9Al0.2Si0.9O3 specimen. It explicitly rejects precise interpretation of the free derivative, not the underlying fit.

source_locations: Kubo et al. (2000), Table I, page 104
primary_data_check.finding: All ten printed run, pressure, lattice, conventional-cell-volume, axial-ratio, and uncertainty rows are directly transcribed. No digitization was required.

parameter_provenance.determination_method: Measurements or their experimental reduction determine this EOS; source: abstract and Experimental section, pages 103-105; Table I, page 104; EOS discussion, Figure 2, Figure 3, and Table II, pages 105-106.
parameter_provenance.equation: Page 106 EOS discussion: all Table I volumes fitted to a third-order Birch-Murnaghan EOS. The paper names but does not explicitly typeset the formula; Peritheos uses the standard Eulerian BM3 convention.
parameter_provenance.V0: Table I ap107 atmospheric row: measured conventional-cell V0=163.6(4) A^3. The source fixed V/V0=1 separately at atmospheric pressure for each run rather than fitting one shared V0.
parameter_provenance.K0: Abstract and page 106: KT0=225.5+/-1.2 GPa when K'T0=4 is assumed.
parameter_provenance.K0_prime: Abstract and page 106: K'T0=4 fixed, chosen for consistency with MgSiO3 perovskite because the experimental compression did not constrain the derivative accurately.
parameter_provenance.temperature_ref: Source says room temperature without a numerical value; encoded operationally as 300 K.
parameter_provenance.fit_selection: All ten Table I rows are retained. They represent eight finite-pressure diffraction patterns plus one atmospheric measurement from each run; ruby pressure is the fit coordinate.
